pin.longFormSummary:
A newly opened ramen restaurant in Tomioka, Teine-ku. The operator confirms its October 22 opening and service from 11:00 to 22:00, with last orders at 21:30. The photo shows the completed Sapporo storefront. Sapporo menu items and prices remain unverified.

The operator announcement now explicitly confirms the Sapporo branch opened October 22, 2026. Its actual storefront photograph also displays October 22 opening signage. The updated exact-branch local report agrees; its older September recruitment estimate is superseded, and no earlier actual public-service evidence was found. This is the physical Sapporo branch opening, not brand founding or another branch date.

Sapporo item names and prices are not yet verified. Checked the exact operator opening page, corporate announcement, linked store directory and images, brand menu and gallery, updated local branch report, exact Japanese branch/address searches and social/photo search leads. The only published priced operator menu explicitly identifies Chiba Makuhari and cannot establish Sapporo availability or prices. The storefront photo does not permit reliable menu transcription. No sibling menu, guessed price, staff benefit or public launch discount is included. Recheck for Sapporo menu photographs after opening.
